purpose: Accuracy-led, newly retrained confirmation; previous v2 test retired from selection

text.source: v2 CMHL retained records, excluding old test entirely
text.initialization: original hfl/chinese-roberta-wwm-ext, never v2 task checkpoints
text.split: 80 KMeans semantic topics, seed 20261026; merge topics linked by old duplicate groups, character 3-5gram cosine >=0.70, or embedding cosine >=0.92; SHA256 topic membership order, 60/20/20 train/validation/confirmation
text.topic_isolation_limit: Operational embedding clusters, not human topic annotations; unknown pretraining contamination
text.overlength: reject over 512 encoder tokens, never truncate
text.checkpoint_selection: validation exact accuracy, then Spearman, then earliest epoch
text.candidate_selection: mean probabilities of 3 seeds; validation exact accuracy, then Spearman, then fixed candidate order
text.classification: argmax of probabilities, lowest class on exact tie
text.baselines: train majority; char TFIDF LogisticRegression C in [0.1,1,10] selected on validation accuracy
text.confirmation: Only selected neural candidate, frozen lightweight baseline and train majority, single report after lock; no follow-up tuning on this confirmation

audio.task: CEAEval manual human expressive appropriateness, not humor or intelligibility
audio.split: retain v2 story partitions; previously unscored train stories split by story hash 70/15/15 into fit/development/confirmation
features: frozen Qwen2.5-Omni audio encoder mean and std
audio.regression: StandardScaler + Ridge alpha in [1,10,100,1000]; no sign flips
audio.selection: development story-bootstrap Spearman point estimate, then MAE, fixed candidate order
audio.confirmation: all fixed candidate/control results, selected method explicitly identified; no post-confirmation selection
audio.duration: all valid complete clips 3..20 seconds; full decode and feature-frame checks
audio.intelligibility: coverage and signal measurements only; no invented human intelligibility label

statistics.unit: semantic topic group for text, story for audio
statistics.text_primary: exact accuracy with correct/n, same-set majority and lightweight baseline

independence_limit: Repartition of a previously used public corpus; confirmation items were v2 training or validation items, but no v2 trained weights or confirmation outcomes enter v3 training/selection. Not a new externally collected dataset.
